primary: At calibration size 384, fitted-simulator SAC minus fitted-model SAA8 later-window nominal reward; cross calibration replicate, training seed and evaluation market. Exploratory with only three independent calibration replicates.
scope: Both use identical public transition logs and the identical fitted simulator. SAC receives additional synthetic interactions, whose count is reported. Only slope, reservation and switch probability are estimated; structural equations, other parameters, reward and noise law are shared correct prior knowledge. Frozen policies/models at deployment; no online refitting. Cases change parameters from the first test period, not within-episode drift. Strong SAA64 supplement is predeclared for nominal and combined at the larger calibration size. No claimed inherent RL robustness.
